scope: Additional phase1-5 evidence gaps; no production binary replacement or whole-Windows recapture.

capture_unit_tests.includes: Valid tiny boot WIM architecture/build incompatibility; missing recovery path; hardlink identity; publication controls.

capture_cli_tests.includes: Actual CLI rejects bounded repeated growth of a disposable 512MiB sparse source while hashing; no output or finalreport; failure journal retained.

raw_ntfs_wim_vertical_slice.command: TMPDIR=/data/cache nix-shell -p ntfs3g wimlib --run 'cargo test --locked -p wim --features disk-capture --test offline_capture raw_ntfs_volume_captures_through_wim_with_independent_stream_bytes -- --ignored --nocapture'
checks: Independently mkntfs/ntfscp-generated raw NTFS -> native manifest -> deferred WIM capture/write after dropping Volume
Unnamed nonresident data and ADS bytes match independently supplied source bytes
Raw security descriptor, Win32 attributes and write timestamp retained
Native WIM verification and independent upstream wimlib-imagex verification pass without warnings
raw_ntfs_wim_vertical_slice.fixture_retention: Ephemeral test fixture removed after assertions; test recreates independent source and compares its full bytes before/after. SHA1 is recorded as an identifier; exact equality is the mutation proof.

limitations: These host fixtures do not establish Windows whole-source DISM equivalence, unusual UTF16/attribute-list fixtures, cross-drive effective permissions, fresh Setup or recovery runtime.
